integrity: Mathematical proof for every electorate with at most three candidates; complete exact-rational finite verification for four candidates and at most three voters, plus an explicit four-voter witness. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unique-winner to unique-winner dichotomous manipulation only. No claim of full strategyproofness when either endpoint ties; the exhaustive search covers four candidates with one, two or three voters only. The accessible full primary paper did not state this threshold; full text of Size Approval Voting was not obtained and historical priority remains a risk.
title: Sharp strict-winner manipulation boundary of flexible-voter-optimal approval voting
